label: Cta Card
description: The closing call-to-action card at video scale: an eyebrow, a headline, a line of support, a brand pill button (a shine crosses it) with an optional secondary link and URL. Fills its slot; type sizes from the box. theme 'brand' paints the card in the primary color.

button_color.label: Button color override (default: the brand primary)

secondary_text.label: Secondary action beside the button (e.g. 'See pricing')

press_at.label: Seconds: the button presses (pair with a cursor click)

theme.label: Card theme: light | dark | brand (primary-colored card); omit to follow the scene ground

surface.label: 'none' drops the card plate: type straight on the scene

at.label: Seconds into the scene the card enters (default 0.2)

exit.label: Fade out before the scene ends (default: hold; the cut is the exit)
